ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Graphisads Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the half year ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Graphisads Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026 both consolidated and standalone.
Appointment — Graphisads Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Shobharam Dhama as Internal Auditor of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27.
Appointment — Graphisads Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Ms. Ritika Agarwal as Tax Auditor of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Graphisads Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

Acquisition — Graphisads Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 50% Share Capital in a newly incorporated company under the name & style of Graphis Growthhon Event Solutions Private Limited.
Updates — Graphisads Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of share and takeover) Regulations, 2011.

Acquisition — Graphisads Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 50% of the shareholding in the Proposed company Graphis Growthhon Event Solutions Private Limited under incorporation process.
General Updates — Graphisads Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates regarding to Accelerated Growth and Strategic Expansion of the Company.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Graphisads Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited Consolidated and Standalone financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.
